Specification: This module defines helper operators for tracking and aggregating named occurrences of boolean conditions, apparently for instrumentation or analysis rather than for a complete state-machine specification. It uses TLC and auxiliary runtime operators to store per-name counters, merge them across workers, and check whether a named condition has been observed. The file contains only helper definitions and state-level/value-level operators, with no declared constants or variables, no transition relation, no temporal specification, and no fault model or correctness property being verified in this module itself.
IfThenElse: IF b THEN IF name \in DOMAIN old THEN [old EXCEPT ![name] = @ + 1] ELSE old @@ (name :> 1) ELSE old @@ (name :> 0)
IF name \in DOMAIN old THEN [old EXCEPT ![name] = @ + 1] ELSE old @@ (name :> 1)
IF name \in DOMAIN a THEN a[name] ELSE 0
IF name \in DOMAIN b THEN b[name] ELSE 0
FunctionConstructor: [name \in (DOMAIN a) \cup (DOMAIN b) |-> (IF name \in DOMAIN a THEN a[name] ELSE 0) + (IF name \in DOMAIN b THEN b[name] ELSE 0)]
